rpcs.name: training_change_member_assignment

rpcs.name: site_project_apply
rpcs.authorization: authenticated applicant; server resolves invite, identity, review path and target entity
rpcs.identity_resolution: private keyed HMAC of normalized identity; never name plus phone and never a client-supplied employee_id or HMAC
rpcs.idempotency: The same authenticated applicant and safe identity for the same project active cycle returns the existing application UUID.

rpcs.name: site_project_review_application
rpcs.authorization: first_project uses site_project_can_manage: current target lead-entity manager or active project_manager/safety_officer for that project; other paths require the current target-entity manager
rpcs.idempotency: Repeating the same completed approve or reject returns the existing result with changed=false after rechecking current authorization.

rpcs.name: site_project_import_application_attachment

rpcs.name: training_contractor_personnel_ledger
rpcs.authorization: RLS and function checks; ordinary project management receives masked identity, not full identity
rpcs.identity_result: always masked for every role; full identity is available only through an explicitly sensitive single-record RPC

first_project.approval_effect: create one employee if still absent, then one current project member

same_entity_cross_project.approval_effect: reuse employee and add a new project member without overwriting old project history

cross_entity.approval_effect: target-entity approval is mandatory; prior entity/project relations remain unchanged

idempotency.application_concurrency: transaction advisory locks cover global identity, project identity and project applicant
idempotency.employee_concurrency: global private identity advisory lock plus a unique private match-token index prevents duplicate personnel
idempotency.member_concurrency: unique project_id + employee_id relation plus ON CONFLICT handling prevents duplicate current membership
idempotency.review_concurrency: application row FOR UPDATE plus identity advisory lock serializes review
client_prohibitions: must not submit employee_id as identity proof
must not create or submit a private identity HMAC

actual_wire: HTTP 401 when JWT is absent or invalid
SQLSTATE P0001 with message 请先登录 when an RPC reaches its auth guard
HTTP 403 or SQLSTATE 42501 for RLS/grant denial
SQLSTATE P0001 with the function-specific 您无权... message
SQLSTATE P0001 with message 项目当前未开放外协人员申请
SQLSTATE P0001 with message 项目当前未开放外协人员申请
SQLSTATE P0001 with message 邀请码无效或已过期
same applicant and identity: HTTP success with the original application UUID
different account for the same identity: SQLSTATE P0001 with message 该人员在本项目已有有效申请
same account with another active identity: SQLSTATE P0001 with message 当前账号在本项目已有其他有效身份申请
SQLSTATE P0001 with message 该身份已绑定其他账号，请联系经营实体管理员核验
SQLSTATE P0001 with message 申请关联人员与安全身份匹配结果不一致

reason_contract.note: The implementation does not emit a separate mismatch value; the required selected type having no matching certificate is missing.

rules: private identity match tokens never leave the database
Vault material is read only inside fixed-search_path SECURITY DEFINER functions
no real identity or signed URL appears in this contract

file_access.upload_binding: join application paths bind project_id, auth.uid and current invite hash; the server also verifies the existing Storage object owner before accepting a reference
file_access.read_authorization: business-record binding plus bound applicant/project/invite path and current project/company/entity permission enforced by Storage RLS
file_access.denied_behavior: unauthorized, cross-project, cross-entity and revoked-role access is denied by current RLS/business permission
file_access.immutability: files bound to archived contracts, documents, applications, personnel photo versions, signatures or confirmations cannot be overwritten or deleted through ordinary client Storage operations
file_access.legacy_bypass: authenticated has no EXECUTE privilege on training_batch_add_contractor_members; new external personnel must use site_project_apply and site_project_review_application

rules: all current project members are in scope when includes_drilling=true
there is no drilling certificate gate
爆破/电工/焊工 certificates are checked only for selected member special_work_types
identity binding must use a controlled server identity mechanism
the client must never receive or submit the private HMAC
name plus phone is not an authoritative identity key
the server decides first_project, same_entity_cross_project or cross_entity
repeat scans and weak-network retries rely on server idempotency
the mini program must not write business tables directly

evidence.compatibility_policy: future changes must remain backward compatible or use an explicit contract version upgrade
